row.proto: void Ui_Node_DispatchEventById_QueueOrRun(void *mgr, void *node, int32_t *eventId, void *ctxA, void *ctxB)
row.notes: Walks node children (+0x30..+0x38) for the first child whose type does not derive from type 0x14612bca8, searches its entry list (child[-3]..child[-2]) for an entry with id (+0x28) == *eventId. If mgr+0x7d54 is 0 the (node, entry) pair is queued in a 1000-slot ring of 0x20-byte items at mgr+0x50 (write index u16 at +0x7d52); otherwise each binding in entry+0x10..+0x18 is run immediately through its handler vtable slots +400 and +0x198. Good hook point for UI event or animation triggers by id.
